tasks.label: Build System Monitor
tasks.command: for /f "usebackq delims=" %p in (`"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath`) do call "%p\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" && cl.exe /Zi /EHsc /nologo /I "${workspaceFolder}\imgui" /I "${workspaceFolder}\imgui\backends" "/Fo${workspaceFolder}\build\\" "/Fd${workspaceFolder}\build\SystemMonitor.pdb" "/Fe${workspaceFolder}\build\SystemMonitor.exe" "${workspaceFolder}\main.cpp" "${workspaceFolder}\lib\imgui.cpp" "${workspaceFolder}\lib\imgui_draw.cpp" "${workspaceFolder}\lib\imgui_widgets.cpp" "${workspaceFolder}\lib\imgui_tables.cpp" "${workspaceFolder}\lib\imgui_impl_win32.cpp" "${workspaceFolder}\lib\imgui_impl_dx11.cpp" /link d3d11.lib user32.lib gdi32.lib
tasks.detail: Builds the ImGui System Monitor project.
